items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and make no new financial or production commitments. Revenue support is insufficient: Amazon reports $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; the $4.92 is in one aggregate row and cannot be assigned to a site. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecast, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because matching-period infrastructure, labor, domain, marketing, commitment, and budget records are missing. AI spend is known for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: $916.914544 across 5,009 calls, including 228 errors and 5 transient errors, but no revenue-linked payback or allocation basis is established. Monthly spend limits, fixed costs, marketing budget, and revenue floor are blank, so budget exposure is unknown rather than zero. Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation, preserving aggregate earnings as unattributed; do not create proposals, change requests, experiments, telemetry, deployments, spend, requeues, or monetization changes.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Minimum finance artifact: reconcile all 18 named provider tracking rows and the aggregate row against matching-period site/content revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, labor and other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved cost-to-learn threshold. Until those fields exist, report contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure burden, and budget capacity as unknown; do not treat missing data as zero.

Reject vanity-metric financial claims. The 30-day scorecard has 3 proven outcomes and 36 improvements awaiting measurement; SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating indicators, not revenue or margin evidence. No forecast or causal-lift claim is supported.
